[[Galen Trask]] is a slave trader who captures and sells slaves to the [[Stone Summit]].  He has been hired by [[Ennis Granitestrider]] to help the [[Deldrimor Dwarves]] infiltrate spies into [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Dialogue==
'''Grenth's Footprint:'''
:''"Trask's the name. Perhaps you've heard of me... I'm quite well-known in these parts."''

:''"Ennis has asked me to find some worthy volunteers to pose as slaves inside Sorrow's Furnace and scout the place out."''

'''Sorrow's Furnace:'''
:''"Some people say what I do is reprehensible, selling folk as slaves to the Stone Summit. But I'm a merchant just like any other. We all have to make a living, you know."''

:''"Now then, what's on your mind?"''
